title: Lexical printing preserves array brackets after a renamed identifier
summary: Renaming the mixed array parameter produced String[] b[] with rank two. Renaming one field in an int declaration left the sibling scalar.

change.description: The lexical printer distinguishes brackets belonging to an element type from brackets written after a parameter or variable name. The landed range includes the separate varargs-test change.

notes: Comma-separated declarators share a base type while brackets after one name affect only that variable.

The intermediate commit ba880df50766 changed only a varargs test. Its javaparser-core/src/main tree (14e3b4368c934db208b4447d68bc67bc8220fc77) is identical to the parent’s. The second commit changed that production tree.
